newsitem.title: UK: Coflexip Stena /Allseas win Texaco contract.
newsitem.headline: Coflexip Stena /Allseas win Texaco contract.

text.p: A joint venture between Paris-based Coflexip Stena Offshore and Allseas Engineering of the Netherlands has won a 37 million stg contract to supply and install pipelines and subsea hardware for Texaco's North Sea Galley field, a Texaco official said on Wednesday.
Texaco said earlier it had won British government approval to develop the field in the central North Sea, with first oil expected in early 1998.
Galley, which has estimated recoverable reserves of 28 million barrels of oil and 40 billion cubic feet of gas, will be developed using a floating production facility (FPF) -- the Northern Producer.
The Coflexip Stena Offshore and Allseas U.K. joint venture will supply and install the subsea wellhead system and the pipeline connecting it to the FPF.
Drilling of two development wells began earlier this month, Texaco said.
